# Weft 1.0.59
- Try the early local Grokbot workflow in **Settings → Preview → Beta features**. It is off by default and uses your existing projects and agent connections. - With Beta enabled, agents can request prepared local workspaces and ready previews through Weft's bundled tools, with parallel worktrees and private task reservations managed in the background. - Beta setup can prepare workspaces for active agents automatically. With Beta off, existing development-role and roster defaults remain in place. - The Dock uses a dashed woven icon while Beta is enabled. Turning it off blocks new background preparation and preview requests while keeping existing task status, cleanup, code and running previews available. - Existing ownership checks, recipe approvals, local-tool permissions and selected preview origins remain enforced. Turning Beta off does not undo edits to your project files. - Retains the performance, startup readiness and reservation-recovery fixes from 1.0.58.
The preview currently supports local CLI/MCP requests. Remote pairing, automatic completion delivery, screenshots, verification of uncommitted edits and cloud fallback remain planned.
Requires macOS 26 or later and Apple silicon. Versions through 1.0.52 require one manual installation to enable in-app updates.
